title: Doctorado en Computación
institution: Universidad de Chile, Facultad de Ciencias Físicas y Matemáticas
about: Universidad de Chile's Doctorado en Computación (Department of Computer Science, FCFM) accepts applications until 31 December of the previous year for March entry, so the deadline for the March 2027 intake is 31 December 2026.
requirements: Licenciado or Magíster degree in a related discipline
Applications accepted until 31 December for March (autumn semester) entry
Applicants seeking ANID scholarships were advised to apply before 31 October
Programme accredited by CNA-Chile for 5 years, until November 2029

upskill.name: the AI Foundations Academy page
why: Record requirement "Licenciado or Magíster degree in a related discipline" and field "Computer science" -> no course objective covers a stated requirement (shortlist matched only the stem "comput"); the AI Foundations Academy page is the closest general fit (e.g. A001.01 objective "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods").
